2607.15562.title: Hard Rules, Soft Preferences: Bridging Reasoning, Learning, and Optimization for Personalized Packing Checklist Generation
2607.15562.paper_summary: Packing for air travel is recurring and error-prone: the checklist must be personal and context-aware, yet feasible under safety rules, item dependencies, and luggage limits. Existing packing assistants are template-driven and generic, or recommendation-driven but unconstrained, leaving users to manually patch regulatory and capacity violations. We propose a reasoning-guided learning framework with three stages: (1) a symbolic engine that generates a regulation-aware seed checklist with explicit dependency structure, (2) a two-stage preference learner that estimates inclusion and priority utilities from user add and remove actions while mitigating survivorship bias, and (3) a CP-SAT optimizer that selects a compact, compliant subset. The architecture instantiates a general pattern for constrained personalization, applicable wherever hard feasibility coexists with sparse preference signals. On 604 labeled trip scenarios, comprising 29K inclusion labels and 343K pairwise comparisons, the symbolic engine attains 99.7% recall and 0.96 rubric validity, compared with 0.78 to 0.81 for frontier LLMs. Gradient-boosted trees and LambdaMART reach an AUC-ROC of 0.943 and an NDCG@5 of 0.923. CP-SAT attains 100% constraint satisfaction, compared with 28% for greedy selection and 10% for random selection. Deployment in FlyEnJoy, a production iOS travel app, doubled checklist completions and reduced editing and completion time.
2607.15562.paper_summary_zh: 打包空中旅行的行李是一個反覆出現且容易出錯的過程：檢查清單必須是個人化且具上下文意識的，同時又必須在安全規則、物品依賴性和行李限制下可行。現有的打包助手要麼是基於模板且通用，要麼是基於推薦但不受約束，這使得用戶不得不手動修補合規性和容量違規問題。我們提出了一個以推理為導向的學習框架，分為三個階段：（1）一個符號引擎生成一個具有明確依賴結構的合規性種子檢查清單，（2）一個兩階段的偏好學習器從用戶的添加和刪除行為中估計包含和優先級效用，同時減輕生存偏差，（3）一個CP-SAT優化器選擇一個緊湊且合規的子集。該架構實現了一種受限個性化的通用模式，適用於硬性可行性與稀疏偏好信號共存的情況。在604個標記的旅行場景中，包括29K的包含標籤和343K的成對比較，符號引擎達到了99.7%的召回率和0.96的標準有效性，相較於前沿的LLM的0.78到0.81。梯度提升樹和LambdaMART達到了0.943的AUC-ROC和0.923的NDCG@5。CP-SAT達到了100%的約束滿足率，而貪婪選擇為28%，隨機選擇為10%。在FlyEnJoy這款生產中的iOS旅行應用中的部署使檢查清單的完成率翻倍，並減少了編輯和完成時間。
